name: PendencyTransferHistory.findPendencyTransferHistoryOrderBySequence
query: SELECT pth FROM PendencyTransferHistory pth WHERE pth.transferId.companyId = :companyId AND pth.transferId.processInstanceId = :processId AND pth.transferId.movementSequence = :movto AND pth.transferId.colleagueId = :colleague AND pth.transferId.transferredSequence = :seqTrans ORDER BY pth.transferId.sequence DESC
